answer: Identities funded from a common source within 18 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. Because the cipher graph is rebuilt each epoch, the whisper merge is applied at settlement and the pigment audit lists every linked key. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet thus collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 21 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
